note: Versioned physical-camera presets for shwfs_ao.detector.physical_camera.v1. Every preset is synthetic_assumed; units: input_e (photoelectrons before EM gain), output_e (after EM gain), adu. Conversion gain is output e-/ADU; read noise is output-referred.

presets.source_note: Synthetic engineering preset (synthetic_assumed): values chosen as representative orders of magnitude for a visible SH-WFS camera of this type; no datasheet (D6) is cited and no commercial camera is implied. Read noise 3 e- follows the R3 contextual SCAO case (B01).

Synthetic engineering preset (synthetic_assumed): values chosen as representative orders of magnitude for a visible SH-WFS camera of this type; no datasheet (D6) is cited and no commercial camera is implied. EM gain 300 lies in the declared Gamma high-gain regime (D1, D2); CIC is pre-register only.

Synthetic engineering preset (synthetic_assumed): values chosen as representative orders of magnitude for a visible SH-WFS camera of this type; no datasheet (D6) is cited and no commercial camera is implied. Per-pixel offset, relative-gain and lognormal read-noise maps model CMOS column/pixel amplifiers.

Synthetic engineering preset (synthetic_assumed): values chosen as representative orders of magnitude for a visible SH-WFS camera of this type; no datasheet (D6) is cited and no commercial camera is implied. As synthetic_emccd@1 plus a declared synthetic electronic coupling kernel (1 % to each nearest and 0.2 % to each diagonal neighbour) placed after saturation and before read noise; a model assumption, not a measured property of any EMCCD (B04).
